uncertainties: Authored by source inspection only: no parser, readback validator or Mermaid render was executed by this author.

expected_fields.runway is the first 'runway <n>' after the command start per airfield_parser.runway_mentions; transmitter group normalisation is not asserted (parse_callsign/_resolve_group not traced).

[WIND] magnetic bearing and [APPROACH_FREQ] in reply nodes are illustrative; the fixture has one combined radio, so contact-tower/approach handover replies need a split-radio fixture (tests/test_airfield.py:341-369).
A_DOWNWIND/A_BASE need field pattern 'left' added to the fixture; the default Ironwood fixture has no pattern and answers 'unable, no published traffic pattern'.
Mermaid: several edges reference nodes defined in later subgraphs; Mermaid normally keeps subgraph membership, but rendering was not checked.
Departure taxi_in session has no automatic end at parking; it persists until checking out, cancel or a lifecycle closure (airfield.py:796-876 has no parked observer).
_status phases 'cancelled' and the 'previous runway clearance no longer current, report intentions' text are covered only in the say-again table, not as dedicated chart nodes.
